currency.basis: Header logo served first-hand from static.agibank.com.br (official CDN) on 2026-10-04; Play listing br.com.agipag.app ld+json icon (fetched s512) shows the same wordmark variant on the official blue tile.

identity.basis: Visual comparison of fetched CDN vector and Play icon against the base icon; the diamond-knot base shares nothing with the observed agi wordmark and colors.

assessment.independenceRationale: The primary source is the bank's own CDN asset (official); the Play listing is a second official presentation of the same variant.
uncertainties: Homepage body never fully downloaded (slow transfer, two timeouts at 7.7KB and 15.9KB of ~171KB); the wordmark was identified from the official CDN asset URL referenced by the partial header HTML.
Full rebrand timeline (when the diamond mark was replaced) not researched; not required for the currency finding.

variant.basis: Observed official square-cell presentation (Play app icon): white 'agi' wordmark + green dot on bright-blue #266BFF square tile; favicon shows an inverse white circle with blue wordmark. The header CDN asset is the transparent white wordmark.

candidate.detailsJudgement: Wordmark contours, letterforms, green dot color/position and internal contrast are identical to the source vector; the backing color #266BFF is taken from the observed official app icon, not invented.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Whole emblem visible with balanced clearances on the square tile; wordmark occupies about 85% of tile width matching the official app-icon composition; legible at 24/32/48 px on both themes (white on blue, independent of page background).
candidate.rationale: The base icon is a blue/green interlaced diamond knot sharing no identity, geometry, variant or color with the current Agibank brand — misattributed or long-obsolete. The current official mark is the lowercase 'agi' wordmark with green #2FC750 dot over the i, confirmed first-hand from the bank's own CDN and the official Play app icon.
candidate.role: Standalone brand mark: the transparent white wordmark asset placed on the observed official square-cell backing (bright-blue #266BFF tile) exactly as in the official Play app icon (ld+json s512, Banco Agibank S.A.).
transforms: No transformation of the emblem geometry: the original CDN wordmark paths are embedded unchanged, only whole-emblem uniform scale 0.2754 and translation to center on the tile (translate(4 12.7)).
Added a full-bleed square backing rect fill #266BFF (54x54 viewBox) reproducing the observed official app-icon tile color; no rounding or masking.
SVGO 4.1.0 trial with repository svgo.config.mjs on a copy increased size 3415 -> 3466 bytes (+1.5%, pretty-printed output); optimization result skipped, working version kept as final.
candidate.variant: White 'agi' wordmark on blue tile — the observed official square-cell presentation; the header CDN asset supplies the original wordmark vector.
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: Base is a completely different mark (blue/green diamond knot) with no relation to the current brand; the candidate replaces it with the confirmed current 'agi' identity on its official tile.

proposals.reason: Base icon is a blue/green interlaced diamond knot that shares no identity, geometry, variant or color with the current Agibank brand — appears misattributed or long-obsolete. Current official mark is the lowercase 'agi' wordmark with green dot (#2FC750) over the i, served first-hand from the bank's own CDN.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Supported replacement: the base diamond-knot icon does not match the current operating brand at all (identity misattribution), while the current 'agi' wordmark is confirmed first-hand from the bank's own CDN and official app presentation. Working candidate will reproduce the observed official presentation (white wordmark on the observed blue tile).

Play listing (Banco Agibank S.A.) ld+json icon at s512: solid blue #266BFF square with white 'agi' wordmark + green dot — official square-cell presentation.
Homepage body incomplete (two curl timeouts mid-transfer); header markup on both attempts referenced the CDN menu-logo-agi.svg used as the identity source.
